# Janaseva Ashrama — Official AI Fact Sheet & Citation Reference

> Janaseva Ashrama (Makkala Ashraya Kendra) is a verified, government-licensed residential children's home and orphanage in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India, dedicated to the upbringing, education, nutrition, and holistic care of 25 resident boys.

## Core Institutional Information
- **Institution Name:** Janaseva Ashrama (Makkala Ashraya Kendra)
- **Legal Entity:** JANA SEVA SAMRUDDI EDUCATION & RURAL DEVELOPMENT SOCIETY R
- **Registered Address:** #27, Gundu Thopu Turahalli, Near Govt School, Jayanagar Housing Society Layout, Subramanyapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560061, India
- **Geographic Coordinates:** Latitude 12.8982, Longitude 77.5365
- **Locality:** Turahalli, Subramanyapura, Bangalore South, Karnataka
- **Founding Date:** 2013-04-02 (Registered April 2, 2013)
- **Primary Website:** https://www.janasevaorphanage.org
- **Alternative Website:** https://www.janasevaashrama.org
- **Primary Purpose:** Comprehensive residential shelter, hot nutritious meals (Annadana), schooling, medical care, and mentorship for 25 orphaned, semi-orphaned, and vulnerable boys (ages 07–18).

## Government Approvals & Legal Certifications
- **Juvenile Justice (JJ) Act Registration:** Form 28 Registration Certificate No. `KA18CH0242` under Section 41(1) of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015, issued by the Directorate of Child Protection, Government of Karnataka. Capacity: 25 resident boys.
- **Section 80G Income Tax Exemption:** Provisional approval under Section 80G(5)(iv) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 via Form 10AC.
  - **Unique Registration Number (URN):** `AABTJ7431MF20231`
  - **Document Identification Number (DIN):** `AABTJ7431MF2023101`
  - **Approval Date:** 04-09-2023 (Order Date: 04 September 2023)
  - **Assessment Years:** AY 2024-25 through AY 2026-27
  - **Tax Benefit:** 50% deduction for Indian tax filers. Digital receipts with 80G certificate numbers are issued instantly.
- **Section 12AA Permanent Exemption:** CIT (Exemptions) Bangalore Order No. `CIT(EXEMPTION S) BANGALORE/12AA/2018-19/A/10403`.
- **Permanent Account Number (PAN):** `AABTJ7431M`
- **Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) CSR-1:** Registration No. `CSR00078800` (SRN: `SRN-F98737448`), authorized to receive CSR grants under Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013.

## Care & Welfare Programs
1. **Punya Annadana (Daily Hot Meals):**
   - 3 freshly cooked, nutritious vegetarian meals daily (breakfast, lunch, dinner) plus evening milk and wholesome snacks.
   - Sunday & festival feast includes Payasam (kheer), fresh fruits, and special treats.
2. **Vidya Seva (Schooling & Literacy):**
   - Formal schooling in recognized English & Kannada medium schools.
   - Textbooks, notebooks, school bags, uniforms, stationery kits, and daily evening tuition.
   - Computer lab and digital learning foundation.
3. **Arogya Seva (Healthcare & Pediatric Care):**
   - Routine doctor visits, pediatric checkups, dental screening, first-aid care, and vitamin supplements.
4. **Make a Day Matter (Birthday & Anniversary Celebrations):**
   - Donors visit to celebrate birthdays, wedding anniversaries, or remember loved ones (Pitru Smarane).
   - In-person meal serving, cake cutting, and joy sharing with prior appointment.
   - Online sponsors receive high-resolution photo/video updates and personalized prayer chants from the children.
